hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: Intercepts exact-input swaps for a hardcoded privileged origin (0xdA88261bfed59aB29ee3C1407cd0060411812347): takes the full input token from the pool manager and returns a BeforeSwapDelta absorbing the specified amount, bypassing normal pool execution. An optional checkOrigin flag (publicly togglable by any caller) can restrict all swaps exclusively to that privileged address.
